thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT P1 — tenant=bluehorizon-prod Detected sudden high rate of 429s from VPC dedicated pool 'dh-01'. 429s at ~82% over the last 5m, correlated with spike in outgoing tokens. Alerting on-call. https://internal.monitoring/alerts/2076543210
Jamal: I'm oncall — I'll take it. Gathering logs and checking pool capacity. Jamal starting runbook 'tenant-429-dedicated' now.
Alex G: Any customer-side reports? Zoe (CSM) can you ping the customer and confirm impact?
Zoe (CSM): Just on it. Pinged Mike (BlueHorizon). He says the UI shows "rate limit exceeded" and their nightly batch import started at 10:12 PDT, likely the trigger.
Mike (BlueHorizon): Confirming errors. Import is failing with 429s, halting critical ingestion. Please advise what you can do.
Jamal: Quick triage: 1) surge from a single token tied to import job; 2) dedicated pool dh-01 hit tenant's per-tenant quota and started returning 429s; shared pools unaffected. Plan: temporary quota override + route overflow to dh-02 + soft token throttle to protect pool. Need CSM approval for emergency contract exception to authorize extra capacity.
Sara: tagging billing to speed review — estimate ~ $1.2k for 30m extra capacity. @billing please ack.
Zoe (CSM): Customer authorizes the charge: Mike says "do it now".
Jamal: Executing override + routing. Command I ran (internal):
```
curl -s -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/tenants/bluehorizon/overrides \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"quota_override": {"mode":"burst","multiplier":3,"duration_minutes":30,"reason":"emergency batch import - customer request"}}'
```
Jamal: Also pushed routing flag to direct overflow to dh-02 and applied token-level soft-throttle (10rps peak).
ops-bot: ACTION TAKEN — override id=ov-9821 created; routing policy updated (dh-01 -> dh-02 overflow); token throttle applied. Monitor: 429 rate decreased from 82% -> 6% in 120s.
Mike (BlueHorizon): We see errors drop and import resumed. Thank you.
Alex G: Good. Keep 5m cadence checks. Next steps: 1) let override run 30m, then auto-revert; 2) post-incident follow-up: update runbook with clearer guidance for customers doing bulk imports and add a pre-approval flow for planned bursts; 3) billing to reconcile the emergency charge.
Sara: Billing acknowledged, we'll process exception and record invoice code.
Jamal: I'll stay on until override expiry and then hand off to Alex for post-incident cleanup/PM. Handoff ETA 2076543510.
Zoe (CSM): I'll coordinate a short customer-facing note and recommend they stagger next import or request a planned burst window.
ops-bot: Severity downgraded to P2. Creating incident record and moving thread to incidents postmortems for a write-up.
Alex G: Please add the customer token id, exact request rate, and pool metrics to the incident ticket. I'll own the postmortem draft if we still see policy gaps.
Mike (BlueHorizon): Appreciate the quick help — will follow up with our SREs to avoid repeats.
Jamal: Monitoring stable, 429s at <5% for last 10m. Leaving this thread open until override auto-reverts.
ops-bot: Thread note: override ov-9821 will auto-revert at +30m unless extended. If anyone extends, add justification and billing approval.
